task_name: Lumora - Lip oil shade concept set
client_brief:
Lip-oil shade concepts for a launch that has one physical sample

Important before you quote: Lumora has one physical lip-oil sample, not seven approved production shades. This is concept-colour work. Every result must say CONCEPT COLOR - SAMPLE APPROVAL REQUIRED.

Final handoff

 Retailer shade card: 8 named exports. The bottle keeps the approved packaging geometry. The concept-colour notice is readable. The displayed shade agrees with its shade name.

 Seven-shade comparison: 1 named export. The seven approved shade names are present. The shades appear in the approved range order. The concept-colour notice is readable.

 Lip oil product-page module: 1 named export. The product name is accurate. The benefit uses the approved claim wording. The concept-colour notice is readable.

 Lip oil launch feed ad: 1 named export. Lumora is identified. The call to action is readable at mobile size. The product edge has no visible halo. The concept-colour notice is readable.

 Lip oil launch story: 1 named export. The headline is readable at mobile size. The call to action remains within the safe area. The concept-colour notice is readable.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.
- Every shade concept must show CONCEPT COLOR - SAMPLE APPROVAL REQUIRED. Only Amber Hour is the physical-sample reference.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Direct to consumer colour cosmetics: one lip oil launching in a seven shade range, sold shade first on mobile with a small retailer feed alongside.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Los Angeles, California; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Lumora is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Los Angeles, California, and this commission covers phase 1: pre-production lip-oil colour concepts.
brand_identity.audience: 18 to 32 year olds discovering us on social and buying shade first on a phone, cross shopping a 6 dollar drugstore oil and a 38 dollar prestige one.
brand_identity.price_positioning: A 24 dollar lip oil. We want to look more expensive than we are while staying honest, so the treatment is bright, clean and daylight neutral, never moody prestige and never blown out drugstore.
brand_identity.typography: Display in a clean confident sans with a little character; text in a neutral daylight sans. The feel is fresh and self assured, neither serif prestige nor bold discount.
brand_identity.voice: Warm, direct, a bit fun, never overclaiming. We describe the finish and let the shade speak. Example line the brand would write: 'A sheer wash of colour, a proper shine, no stickiness.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The wordmark and shade lockups exist as working digital files. There is no printed guideline; the carton photograph we have was shot under shop light and should not be trusted as a colour reference.
brand_identity.values: That the shade on the screen is the shade on the lip, and that a launch can look premium without pretending to be prestige.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
Color variants are approval concepts until physical samples are photographed and signed off.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export and the separately listed editable source.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
